summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments from automated and human reviewers, implementing fixes for valid issues and responding to/resolving each thread.
summary.outcome: All 7 unresolved review threads addressed: 6 fixed (OpenAPI type, hex regex validation, owner-edit guard bug, lockfile version, upgradingId state leak) and 1 marked not applicable. All 217 tests pass and changes pushed.

repo: Hex field validators must use even-length regex (e.g., /^([0-9a-fA-F]{2})+$/) to ensure valid byte boundaries — applies to encryptedKey, encryptedFileKey, and shareId fields across create-share.dto.ts and share-key.dto.ts
The ipns.service.ts had an overly aggressive guard that blocked owners from editing files uploaded by recipients — this was a real bug introduced alongside the H-02 security fix
tee-worker/package-lock.json lockfileVersion must match the version in package.json; drift causes CI issues
The TextEditorDialog fallback for non-recipients is intentionally non-functional as part of an H-02 security fix — not a bug
api:generate runs ESLint across the whole repo including sdk-e2e tests; pre-existing lint errors in tests/sdk-e2e/src/suites/error-cases.test.ts will surface during client regeneration

code.finding: upgradingId was set before early returns at lines 374 and 380, leaving state stuck. Fixed by wrapping the handler body in try/finally to guarantee clearance.
Guard that blocked write operations on recipient-uploaded files also incorrectly blocked owner edits. Removed guard; also required removing the now-unused ForbiddenException import to pass typecheck.
OpenAPI type annotation was incorrect; fixed to match actual field type for proper client generation.

workflow: When removing a guard/check, always grep for the exception class it imported to catch orphaned imports before running typecheck

api:generate regenerates the OpenAPI client and runs repo-wide lint — pre-existing lint errors in unrelated files will appear as noise; verify the actual generated output was updated before investigating
PR review resolution workflow: triage first (valid/already-addressed/not-applicable), implement all fixes, run tests, then batch commit+push before replying and resolving threads

friction: Removing the ipns.service guard left an orphaned ForbiddenException import that caused a typecheck/lint failure, requiring a second edit pass

api:generate surfaces pre-existing ESLint errors in sdk-e2e tests (error-cases.test.ts) unrelated to the changes, creating noise that required investigation to confirm it was not caused by the current edits
The ipns.service.spec.ts test for the removed guard needed to be located and updated after the guard was removed — test failure was the signal, not proactive awareness
open_items: Pre-existing ESLint error in tests/sdk-e2e/src/suites/error-cases.test.ts (ForbiddenException usage) was not fixed — flagged as pre-existing and left for a separate cleanup
TextEditorDialog fallback behavior for non-recipients (marked not-applicable, thread #1) may warrant a UX-level follow-up to surface a clear error state rather than silently failing
